custom_checks.name: candidate_unique_week_and_product_group
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT _date, product_group FROM {table} GROUP BY _date, product_group HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

custom_checks.name: mapped_delivery_spend_unchanged
custom_checks.sql: SELECT SUM(_spend) AS value FROM {table} WHERE product_group != 'UNMAPPED'

custom_checks.name: mapped_delivery_impressions_unchanged
custom_checks.sql: SELECT SUM(_impressions) AS value FROM {table} WHERE product_group != 'UNMAPPED'

custom_checks.name: unmapped_delivery_has_no_sales
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(sales_dollars IS NOT NULL OR sales_tdp IS NOT NULL) AS value FROM {table} WHERE product_group = 'UNMAPPED'

custom_checks.name: synthetic_unmapped_delivery_has_no_sales
custom_checks.sql: WITH synthetic_media AS (SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS mapped_product_group, CAST(125 AS NUMERIC) AS delivered_spend), classified AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(mapped_product_group), ''), 'UNMAPPED') AS product_group, delivered_spend FROM synthetic_media), product_sales AS (SELECT 'PROTEIN GRANOLA' AS product_group, CAST(100 AS NUMERIC) AS sales_dollars) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT classified.product_group, classified.delivered_spend, product_sales.sales_dollars FROM classified LEFT JOIN product_sales USING (product_group)) WHERE product_group = 'UNMAPPED' AND delivered_spend = 125 AND sales_dollars IS NULL
